harness_hardening_delivered: Foreground identity from the uiautomator package; DOM taps are refused while a native window covers the app and fail closed when the foreground cannot be verified (the recorded failure had a mounted Home WebView behind com.google.android.documentsui while mCurrentFocus was null).
Bounded, re-verified KEYCODE_BACK cleanup between cases; a case blocked by a leftover native window reports BLOCKED_PREVIOUS_CASE_NATIVE_WINDOW instead of tapping behind it.
State-driven chooser walk with settled-geometry taps (the recorded mid-animation drawer tap had landed on the wrong row) and exact 'Downloads' vs 'Download' disambiguation.
MediaProjection consent decided from the live hierarchy only, opening the API 35 capture-mode selector before confirming, and never matching the app name from a dialog title.
WebView session recovery so a dead renderer cannot cascade into later cases, plus an independent on-device fixture check so a staging failure is never reported as a navigation failure.
